predecessors.name: House of Khalifa
predecessors.text: the islands of Bahrain, British-protected under the House of Khalifa until 1971

ledger.x: April 1986: Qatar acts on Fasht al-Dibal.
March 2001: the International Court of Justice rules.
March 2001: the Court awards Qit'at Jaradah to Bahrain.
14 February 2002: the State of Bahrain becomes the Kingdom of Bahrain.

wars.name: Qatar v. Bahrain
wars.outcome: After the Fasht al-Dibal incident of April 1986 and Qatar's filing at the ICJ in July 1991, the Court's judgment of March 2001 confirmed Bahrain's title to 16 of the 17 Hawar elements (British decision of 1939) and gave it Qit'at Jaradah, and gave Qatar…

wars.name: 2011 Bahraini uprising
wars.outcome: Protests began in early 2011; Bahrain 'requested security assistance from Saudi Arabia and other Gulf Cooperation Council countries' a month later and declared a three-month state of emergency.

certainty.note: The Hawar Islands and Fasht al-Dibal were disputed with Qatar until the 2001 judgment; the islands' coasts were also being reclaimed (the page's 665 to 780 km2).
The ICJ judgment of March 2001 fixed the Bahrain-Qatar title; reclamation keeps adding land (the page counts 84 islands and island groups by August 2008).
